blocks.text: To create the Tanium data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Tanium data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
In the Tanium Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.

In the field, optionally enter the sensor names. A sensor is a script that runs on endpoints to gather specific data in response to a Tanium question. To add multiple sensors, press Enter after each entry. To learn more, refer to the Tanium documentation.
